title: Merge loop body
statement: The body sets both completion counters to zero and then repeats while their sum is less than the sum of the two list lengths. When both lists have remaining elements, it takes the next element from the second list if that element is smaller than the next element from the first list, and otherwise takes the next element from the first list; when only one list has remaining elements, it takes the next element from that list.
